comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Spiral (7-knob). Spiral — a delay whose repeats climb or sink. A grain-re-triggered tap is read at `ratio` inside the FEEDBACK loop, so the shift compounds: repeat 1 is one step away, repeat 2 two steps, an endless staircase fading with the feedback. Rise sets a constant ratio (bipolar, unity at centre) for the discrete per-repeat staircase; Glide+Span are an onset-triggered ramp on that same ratio: a note resets the ramp to ZERO and it then climbs toward Glide's depth over Span, so the repeats begin at pitch and drift away over a while. That is the 'slowly rises for a while' behaviour; it is deliberately not a decay back to unity. Glide 0 = pure staircase; Rise centred + Glide up = pure glide with no net transposition. Ratio mapping is piecewise LINEAR, not 2^(semis/12), because the pedal cannot call exp2 without a helper call.
fxid_comment: 0x01C1. Free: no stock effect uses it, not a retired custom alias (checked against tools/effects_db.json). Sits just below the 450-459 custom block.

params.name: Time
params.comment: Delay length, squared curve 4096..52920 samples (~93 ms .. 1.2 s). The floor is also the tap-overtake guard: the grain gains G*(ratio-1) <= 3072 on the writer, so D must stay above that.

params.name: Feedbk
params.comment: Repeats. Scaled to 0.92 max and the loop is soft-clipped, so a compounding shift cannot run away.

params.name: Rise
params.comment: Pitch step PER REPEAT (the staircase). 0 = octave down, 50 = unity, 100 = octave up. Bipolar, unity at centre.

params.name: Glide
params.comment: How FAR the pitch travels over the rise (depth). Follows Rise's direction. Paired with Span, which sets how long it takes.

params.name: Span
params.comment: How LONG the rise takes after a note: squared curve ~0.2 s .. 8 s. A note onset resets the ramp to zero and it then climbs toward full Glide depth over Span, so the repeats start at pitch and drift away — not the other way round.

params.name: Tone
params.comment: Low-pass INSIDE the loop, so the climb dulls with each pass instead of turning harsh.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet. Default 1 (quiet-safe) like the rest of the pack.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
